plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the Solstice Bank freelancer onboarding flow, including the landing page, the 8-step application, recovery paths, and confirmation state across both desktop and mobile viewports.
plan.summary: The run will start by assessing the landing page and its mobile layout warnings, then proceed through the 8-step apply flow as a freelancer. It will deliberately trigger validation errors, test the step navigation, interact with the floating help drawer, and attempt recovery paths like 'Save & continue later' and 'Cancel'. Finally, it will complete the application to reach the confirmation page and verify the end-state.
assumptions: The 8-step form uses client-side JavaScript to switch sections, so navigation and validation can be tested without server calls.
Mock interactions like the ID photo upload, liveness countdown, and external bank OAuth are fully functional in the local demo.
The 'Save & continue later' and 'Cancel application' flows simulate their respective states or modals without actually exiting the page.
Small tap target warnings on the landing page nav links will be more impactful during the mobile viewport checks.
risk_hotspots: apply.html Step 1: Consent checkboxes and long legal text readability, especially on mobile
apply.html Step 5: ID verification photo upload mock and liveness 3-2-1 countdown modal behavior
apply.html Step 6: Risk questionnaire soft warning trigger when compared against income
apply.html Step 7: Mock OAuth flow for linking external banks and its error/cancel handling
apply.html: 'Save & continue later' and 'Cancel application' second-confirmation modal interactions
index.html: Multiple small tap targets for navigation links causing mobile accessibility issues

phases.title: Landing Page Evaluation
phases.objective: Assess the first impression, value proposition clarity, and mobile layout of the index page.
key_checks: Verify hero section layout and decorative credit card rendering
Check 'Materials to prepare' checklist visibility and clarity
Click top nav 'Open an account' and hero 'Start application' to ensure they route to apply.html
Evaluate mobile viewport for small tap target severity on nav links
exit_criteria: Both CTA links clicked and verified
Mobile viewport layout assessed for tap target warnings

phases.title: Onboarding Steps 1-4
phases.objective: Navigate the initial eligibility, personal info, contact, and employment steps as a freelancer, testing validation and progress indicators.
key_checks: Attempt to continue Step 1 without checking consent boxes to trigger validation error
Fill Step 2 personal info (name, DOB, masked SSN)
Fill Step 3 contact and US address
Select 'freelance / self-employed' in Step 4 employment and fill income
Verify progress bar updates and completed step dots are clickable to go back
exit_criteria: Validation error triggered and resolved on Step 1

phases.title: Onboarding Steps 5-8 & Review
phases.objective: Complete the high-risk ID verification, risk questionnaire, funding, and review steps, testing complex interactions and soft warnings.
key_checks: Interact with Step 5 front/back photo upload mock and trigger liveness 3-2-1 countdown modal
Answer Step 6 risk questionnaire to intentionally trigger the soft warning compared against income
Use Step 7 mock OAuth to link an external bank from the 4 fictional options
Use Step 8 Review 'Edit' buttons to jump back to a previous section and change data
Verify floating Help drawer opens and displays step-specific copy
exit_criteria: Mock bank linked in funding step

phases.title: Recovery & Interruption Paths
phases.objective: Test the 'Save & continue later' and 'Cancel application' flows to ensure graceful handling of user abandonment.
key_checks: Click 'Save & continue later' and observe the resulting state or modal
Click 'Cancel application' and verify the second-confirmation dialog appears
Dismiss the cancel confirmation to ensure the application state is preserved
exit_criteria: Cancel second-confirmation triggered and dismissed without losing current progress

phases.title: Submission & Confirmation
phases.objective: Complete the application and validate the success state, animation, and reference number.
key_checks: Submit the completed application from the Review step
Verify animated checkmark plays on confirmation.html
Check that a random application number (SOL-2026-XXXX-XX) is displayed
Click 'Back to home' link to ensure it routes to index.html
exit_criteria: Confirmation page fully validated including animation and reference number

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Deep Dive
phases.objective: Re-run critical checks on a mobile viewport to identify responsive design issues, especially forms and modals.
key_checks: Re-evaluate index.html nav tap targets on mobile
Walk through apply.html steps 1-8 on mobile to check form input usability, modals (liveness, cancel), and the help drawer
Verify confirmation page layout and animation on a smaller screen
exit_criteria: Mobile viewport checks completed for all three pages

coverage_targets.features: exercise all 8 onboarding steps, modals, navigation, and error states per key page
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks and form interactions on mobile viewport to validate responsive behavior

notes: Pay special attention to the liveness countdown modal and mock OAuth as these are common friction points in onboarding.
The risk questionnaire soft warning is a key UX detail for the freelancer segment; ensure the copy is helpful and dismissible.
Small tap targets on the landing page nav were flagged in prescan; verify if these persist or worsen on mobile.
